job.prompt: Create production game interaction keyframes of our exact existing ADULT Kimi: silvery lavender hair fading pale blue, violet eyes, navy ribbon and moon ornament. Reference 1 defines the exact wedding outfit and colors to KEEP in every frame.  Reference 2, if present, supplies mature body proportions and identity only, never its other clothes. Preserve reference portrait mature adult 25+ face, natural small head, long thighs and shins, about 7.5 head lengths tall. Photorealistic 3D digital human rendering. Preserve identity, face, hairstyle, ornament and exact outfit/footwear. Body and legs cannot shrink in later cells. No chibi or doll anatomy. Accurate connected fingers/wrists. No shadows, floor, backdrop, text, labels or grid. True transparent alpha. LAYOUT: FOUR complete FULL BODY figures, TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, square 2048x2048 transparent atlas. The whole top row fits y=6% to 43%; the whole bottom row fits y=56% to 93%. Copy the SAME full-height base body at EXACTLY the same scale into every cell, then change ONLY arms/face for the gestures. Heads, waist, knees and ankles remain at identical cell-relative levels. Leave empty transparent space below all four pairs of shoes and between all hair and gowns. Keep full gown and veil inside each cell. No overlapping people. Do not crop or shorten anyone to fit the canvas. Order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.  FOUR POSES:  1) High-five preparation: her RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT) rises to shoulder height, relaxed open palm. 2) High-five ready: the same connected arm, open palm facing viewer beside her temple, NOT above head; five natural fingers. 3) High-five contact: the same palm gently presses forward toward viewer at shoulder/temple level; a small happy smile; natural elbow and wrist, no separate floating arm. 4) High-five recoil: hand withdraws slightly back beside shoulder, open relaxed fingers, pleased smile. Left arm rests by side throughout.
